justification: Bug 4 Stage 2: replace the silent blank on the apartment/strata brief with an honest scope note explaining why development-capacity analysis is not provided. Factual scope statement only — no advice, no computed yield. Closes Bug 4 as scoped (show strata-appropriate output instead of a silent blank).

pre_impl.existing_data: RenovationBrief already has an unused scope_limitations list field; both assembly paths (non-streaming + streaming) constructed it with no scope_limitations, defaulting to an empty list, so apartment/ambiguous briefs showed neither capacity nor any explanation.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 4-stage plan over-scoped this into computed apartment yield + dev_type-by-zone; the proportionality decision deferred those (Stages 3-4) as a product/liability call. Stage 2 is the minimal liability-reducing close.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Additive: a pure _strata_scope_note(strata_type) helper plus a scope_limitations argument on the two existing RenovationBrief constructions. No yield computed; no change to classification or the development brief path.

functions.name: _strata_scope_note
functions.input: the StrataType classification computed for this address
functions.output: a list holding one honest scope-note string, or an empty list
functions.if_none: DEVELOPMENT and NOT_STRATA states return an empty list (no note needed)

values: N/A - no regulatory values computed or hardcoded; the helper returns fixed factual scope-statement copy, guarded by a test against the pre-pr-review liability vocabulary
queries: N/A - no database queries; the helper is a pure function of the StrataType enum value

break_it.scenario: Confirmed apartment lot would otherwise show a silent blank capacity section
break_it.what_happens: User sees an empty capacity area and may read it as 'no constraints' rather than 'out of scope'
break_it.how: returns an explicit scope note; test_scope_note_is_not_a_silent_blank asserts non-empty text for APARTMENT and AMBIGUOUS

break_it.scenario: Ambiguous strata status is silently treated as no development potential
break_it.what_happens: A possibly-developable lot reads as having nothing, a quiet misstatement
break_it.how: distinct AMBIGUOUS note states status could not be determined and what resolves it; test_ambiguous_has_distinct_scope_note

break_it.scenario: Scope copy drifts into advisory or liability-laden language over time
break_it.what_happens: User-facing strings could imply advice, suitability, or a guarantee
break_it.repro: any edit to the scope-note strings
break_it.how: test_copy_has_no_banned_liability_language greps every note against the pre-pr-review.md banned-term list and fails on any match

post_merge.manual_verify: On a known apartment address confirm the brief now shows the scope note instead of an empty capacity section. Stages 3 (computed apartment yield / dev_type-by-zone) and 4 (CTA) are deferred per the proportionality decision in ce-bug4-strata-capacity-salvage-2026-06.md.
